title: A thermocouple catching up
caption: After a sudden temperature step a thermocouple with τ = 0.5 s closes the gap as 1 − e^{−t/τ}. It is within 1% when e^{−t/τ} = 0.01, that is t = τ ln 100 = 4.6τ = 2.3 s. After one τ it has covered only 63%.
alt: Curve of the fraction of the final reading against time, rising to 63 percent at 0.5 seconds and reaching 99 percent at 2.3 seconds.
description: Horizontal axis: time since the step in seconds; vertical axis: the fraction of the new temperature that the thermocouple reads.
The curve is 1 − e^{−t/τ} with τ = 0.5 s: 63% at t = 0.5 s.
The reading is within 1% (0.99, dashed line) at t = τ ln 100 = 2.3 s ≈ 2.3 s.
